Only enable this if you know the modules are safe to block on your device. To recover, flash the stock boot / init_boot image with fastboot.
Comma-separated module names to stop from loading at boot, e.g. oplus_secure_guard. Leave empty to block nothing.
Module names may contain only letters, digits and underscores, each at most 64 characters.

Jailbreak mode is active, so system partition protection is always on. Every module install is scanned before it runs - including an install started from a terminal: red is refused, yellow asks you to confirm with the volume keys, green installs directly.

The kernel is not loaded yet. You can have this app gain root through the bundled exploit and immediately enter jailbreak (late-load) mode, without touching any partition. Or install the kernel manually.
DirtyFrag is installed. In its SU Manager card pick this app, then press Run exploit; root comes back here through ksud late-load.
Opened DirtyFrag: pick this app as the SU manager, then press Run exploit.
Bundled DirtyFrag %1$s is ready. Handed the installer to the system; when it finishes, open it and press Run exploit.
Could not download or install DirtyFrag. Check the network, or install it by hand from its releases page.
The exploit is not bundled for this device.
Jailbreak failed. The kernel may be unsupported; check the logs.
Scanning is on by default. This switch only controls installs started from this manager (installs started from a terminal or the web UI are still scanned); in jailbreak mode it is always on.
Always on in jailbreak mode and cannot be turned off here - a late-loaded session cannot undo a real partition write.

Stop reporting that a manager is installed and that the module arrived after boot. Every other process — including the ones that look for root — is told a plain device. The app keeps its root rights, so this switch stays reachable; turn it off here, or run `ksud stealth set 0` from a shell.
Type these digits in the calculator and press = to open the web manager. Digits only; leave it empty to use the built-in default.
